title: Gramophone surface noise (from the 1923 78rpm 'Dippermouth Blues', King Oliver's Creole Jazz Band)
creator: King Oliver's Creole Jazz Band (source recording); loop assembled for this project
notes: Built only from the lead-in/run-out groove noise of the public-domain 78 transfer (no music): shuffled 0.45-0.9 s grains with 40 ms crossfades, 300 ms loop crossfade; ~-21 LUFS (limited by click true-peaks).
